meta.name: google-maps-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users automatically scrape business data from Google Maps using the BrowserAct Google Maps API. Agent should proactively trigger this skill for needs like finding restaurants in a specific city, extracting contact info of dental clinics, researching local competitors, collecting addresses of coffee shops, generating lead lists for specific industries, monitoring business ratings and reviews, getting opening hours of local services, finding specialized stores (e.g., Turkish-style restaurants), analyzing business categories in a region, extracting website links from local businesses, gathering phone numbers for sales outreach, mapping out service providers in a specific country.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图自动提取商家数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取地图上的商家联系方式用于销售或调研。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract business data from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk collect business contacts from Google Maps for sales or research.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的要求，自动从 Google Maps 抓取商家数据，包括名称、类别、地址、电话、网站、评分、评论数和营业状态。
howto.when: 当你需要查找特定类型的商家（如餐厅、诊所）、收集联系方式或分析市场时，Claude 会主动触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我找一下纽约评分高的咖啡店。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 提取洛杉矶牙科诊所的电话和网站。
列出旧金山土耳其餐厅的地址和评分。
say.note: Claude 会输出结构化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically scrape business data from Google Maps based on your request, including name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, and business status.
howto.when_en: Claude proactively triggers this skill when you need to find specific types of businesses (e.g., restaurants, clinics), collect contact info, or analyze markets.

say_en.text: Find top-rated coffee shops in New York.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return results.

say_en.text: Extract phone numbers and websites of dental clinics in LA.
List addresses and ratings of Turkish restaurants in SF.
